clips.line: But I had to cancel because Angela’s party is mandatory.
clips.note: He wanted to go to a museum (the Met) in New York tonight. He can’t: everyone has to go to Angela’s party.
around: I was going to be in New York tonight to go to the Met,

clips.line: And public school is mandatory and public school is free.
clips.note: He talks about school: all children have to go, and public school costs nothing.

clips.line: It’s not mandatory, but we do hope our employees will take the opportunity
clips.note: A company leader says the workers don’t have to do it, but the company hopes they will.

clips.line: And the important thing is, summer school is not mandatory
clips.note: She says students don’t have to go to summer school. They can choose.

clips.line: I had to attend some mandatory classes,
clips.note: He had to go to some classes. He had no choice.
